## 1. Participation Details
Users are deemed to have read and agreed to the Bitget Simple Earn Product Agreement.
Promotion rewards apply to main accounts only and are valid only during the promotion period. Institutional users are not currently eligible.
To view the Simple Earn APR boost promotion in the app, update the Bitget app to version V2.91.0 or later.
## 2. Net deposit calculation
Net deposit amount = deposit amount − withdrawal amount. Internal transfers are not counted.
The USDT activity tracks net deposits in USDT, USDC and USDGO, all converted to USDT for calculation. The BTC, ETH and XAUT activities track net deposits of the respective coins only.
## 3. Eligibility updates and effective time
The system checks each user's net deposits and subscriptions daily and automatically updates promotion eligibility between 12:00 AM and 8:00 AM (UTC+8) the following day. Once eligibility is updated, the corresponding Simple Earn product starts earning the boost; users who do not meet the conditions receive the base APR only.
Both net deposit and interest accrual follow T+1 logic. For example, a subscription or net deposit completed between 11:00 PM and 11:59:59 PM (UTC+8) on day D is counted as of 12:00 AM on day D+1, and promotion eligibility is updated on day D+2.
## 4. Boost calculation and limits
Promotion rewards apply only to principal within each promotion's boost cap. Any amount above the cap does not earn the promotion boost.
Promotion rewards are calculated daily on the user's hourly average holdings from the previous day.
Redeeming principal during the promotion period may void your eligibility or affect the bonus APR you are currently earning.
Total promotion rewards are capped and allocated on a first-come, first-served basis. Individual rewards are also capped; once your individual cap is reached, no further promotion rewards will be granted.

Users must complete identity verification and meet the product and promotion eligibility requirements that apply in their country or region.
Data, limits, APRs and reward estimates displayed on the promotion page are for reference only. The final basis is Bitget's backend settlement records and the relevant promotion announcements. All participants must strictly comply with Bitget's terms and conditions. If fraud, the use of multiple accounts to claim rewards, or participation through electronic, bot, duplicate or automated means is detected, Bitget reserves the right to disqualify the participant and revoke their rewards, and promotion rewards on the relevant accounts will be voided.
This promotion is open only to users who meet Bitget's eligibility requirements and whose participation is not restricted by applicable laws, regulatory requirements, regional restrictions, or Bitget's internal policies. Users in restricted regions, users with restricted accounts, and any other users who do not meet Bitget's eligibility requirements may not register for or participate in this promotion, or receive or claim any promotion rewards. Users are responsible for confirming that their participation does not violate the laws and regulations that apply in their location. Bitget may adjust eligibility for this promotion based on legal, regulatory, or risk control requirements. Eligibility, eligible trading volume, and rewards are determined in accordance with these promotion rules and Bitget's final backend settlement records. To the extent permitted by applicable law, Bitget may adjust, suspend, or cancel this promotion due to legal or regulatory requirements, risk control, market changes, system maintenance, force majeure, or other reasonable and necessary causes.
By participating in this promotion, you are deemed to have read, understood, and agreed to the Bitget User Agreement, Privacy Policy, applicable product terms, risk disclosures, and these promotion rules. OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Your Voice, Our Products.
The Bitget Community Product Officer Program is back and better than ever!
With three exciting product challenges covering the U.S. Stocks, CFDs, and AI, it's time to take your product experience to the next level. Share your insights, showcase your creativity, and compete for a share of the 3,000 USDT prize pool!
Join the upgraded Q4 Community Product Officer Program today. Your experience matters. Your voice shapes what's next!
Join Now.
## Campaign Period & Rewards
Campaign Period: November 16 – December 12, 2026
Campaign Format: Three themed product experience challenges, 9 days each
Total Prize Pool: 3,000 USDT
Total Winning Spots: 165 (55 per challenge)
Platform: X (Twitter)
Eligibility: All Bitget users
## Three Product Experience Challenges
The campaign features three challenges covering Bitget's key product areas. Each challenge comes with a
1,000 USDT prize pool. Participants can join the challenges that match their interests and product experience.
## Phase 1 | My Bitget U.S. Stock Product Experience
Campaign Period: November 16 – November 24
Prize Pool: 1,000 USDT
Explore Bitget's U.S. stock products, including rToken (tokenized stocks) and Stock Perps (stock perpetual futures), and share your real trading experiences.
## Suggested Topics:
rToken Experience: Share your experience with tokenized stocks, including trading processes, interface design, and ease of use.
Stock Perps Experience: Review order placement, leverage features, trading costs, and risk management tools.
Product Feature Reviews: Highlight your favorite U.S. stock trading features and explain their benefits and use cases.
Product Comparisons & Suggestions: Compare Bitget's U.S. stock products with other platforms and share their strengths and areas for improvement.
Recommended Formats: Trading screenshots, feature reviews, product comparisons, visual analyses, and short videos.
## Phase 2 | My Bitget CFD Product Experience
Campaign Period: November 25 – December 3
Explore Bitget's key CFD features and share your real experiences, product reviews, and suggestions for improvement.
CFD Demo Trading: Share your demo trading experience, trading process, and how the demo account helps you become familiar with CFD trading.
Customizable Leverage: Review leverage adjustment features, flexibility, ease of use, and risk management experience.
Professional Trading Platform: Share your experience with MT5, charting tools, and advanced trading features.
CFD Account Types: Review different account types, including Zero-Fee, ECN, Pro (invitation only), and Standard+, focusing on fees, spreads, and use cases.
Trading Experience & Suggestions: Evaluate order execution, trading costs, product features, and areas for improvement.
Recommended Formats: Demo trading screenshots, feature demonstrations, account comparisons, product reviews, and short videos.
## Phase 3 | My Bitget AI Product Experience
Campaign Period: December 4 – December 12
Explore Bitget's AI-powered products, GetAgent and Agent Hub, and discover how AI can support market analysis, trading research, and operational efficiency.
GetAgent Experience: Share your experience with AI interactions, market information searches, price analysis, and AI-powered trading assistance.
Agent Hub Exploration
: Explore different AI Agents and share their features, practical applications, and usefulness.
AI Trading Assistance Reviews: Evaluate how AI supports market research, information gathering, trading strategy analysis, and efficiency.
Product Improvement Suggestions: Provide feedback on feature design, response accuracy, user experience, and practical value.
Recommended Formats: AI conversation screenshots, feature demonstrations, product reviews, visual reports, and short videos.
## How to Participate
Step 1 | Join Bitget Product Fan Club
Join the Bitget Product Fan Club and participate as a Community Product Officer by exploring the featured products in each challenge.
Join Here.
Step 2 | Share Your Product Experience on X
Publish an original post on X related to the current challenge theme, sharing your real product experience, feature reviews, or improvement suggestions.
## Your post must include both campaign hashtags:
We encourage you to include product screenshots, demonstration videos, or detailed feature analyses to make your content more informative and valuable.
Step 3 | Submit Your Entry
After publishing your post, complete the campaign submission form with the following information:
Bitget UID
X post link
Campaign phase
Submission Link
Step 4 | Get Recognized & Rewarded
Bitget will evaluate submissions based on content quality, product experience depth, originality, and social engagement. Outstanding participants will have the opportunity to win USDT rewards.
## Campaign Rewards
The Q4 Community Product Officer Program offers a total prize pool of 3,000 USDT, with 1,000 USDT allocated to each phase and 165 winning spots across all three challenges.
## Reward Breakdown Per Phase:
Award Category | Winners | Reward per Winner
Best Product Review | 5 | 40 USDT
Most Valuable Feedback | 10 | 25 USDT
Best Creative Content | 10 | 20 USDT
Community Choice Award | 10 | 15 USDT
Participation Reward | 20 | 10 USDT
Total per Phase | 55 | 1,000 USDT Prize Pool
Total Across Three Phases: 165 Winning Spots and 3,000 USDT in Rewards.
The winners are scheduled to be announced on December 13, 2026, subject to the official announcement.
## Evaluation Criteria
All eligible submissions will be evaluated based on the following criteria:
Authenticity: Whether the content reflects genuine product usage and real-world experiences.
Depth of Product Experience: Whether the review provides detailed insights into specific product features and practical use cases.
Value of Feedback: Whether the suggestions are clear, constructive, and actionable.
Originality & Creativity: Whether the content is original and presents product experiences in an engaging way.
Community Engagement & Reach: The post's visibility, engagement, and overall social reach.
Priority will be given to authentic, insightful, and high-quality original content. Social engagement and reach will be considered as supporting factors rather than the sole criteria.
Valuable product feedback may also be collected and shared with the Bitget product team to support future product improvements.
## Campaign Rules & Terms
The campaign is open to all Bitget users. Participants must provide a valid Bitget UID and complete the required posting and submission steps.
All submissions must relate to the designated product theme of the corresponding phase and be based on genuine product experiences.
X posts must include both #BitgetCommunityProductOfficer and #BitgetFans.
Participants must publish their content within the corresponding campaign period and submit a valid X post link and required information through the designated form.
Plagiarism, copied content, fabricated feedback, artificial engagement, or other fraudulent activities are strictly prohibited and may result in disqualification.
Duplicate submissions of the same content will only be counted once. Posts must remain publicly accessible during the evaluation period for verification.
Rewards will be distributed based on the final evaluation results. The official winner announcement and reward distribution arrangements will be determined by Bitget.
Bitget reserves the right to modify and interpret the campaign rules to the extent permitted by applicable laws.
